title: Palettes
description: Named color ramps a character's parts can be redrawn in, such as a vest in gray instead of gold. A ramp has one color per tone, and each shape in a part takes the color of its tone, read from its layer name: a layer named "vest-mid" takes the ramp's "mid".

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete and hover help.

tones.description: The tone names, lightest first. A layer named "<part>-<tone>" is that tone; a shape with no tone name takes the tone whose color is nearest its own in brightness.

palettes.description: The ramps, keyed by the name a render uses, such as "gray" in "render": { "left-vest": "gray" }.

additionalProperties.description: One color per tone. A tone left out takes the color of the nearest tone that has one.
